code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, pancytopenia (low leukocytes, erythrocytes, and platelets), neutropenia, lymphopenia, and elevated basophils and eosinophils. Creatinine is mildly elevated, suggesting possible renal impairment. Low total CO₂ may indicate metabolic acidosis. These findings are concerning for bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible hypoxic injury, and renal dysfunction. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
